intro: A short checkpoint on the first half of this module, in your own AI assistant with voice on: you are the spokesperson of a company that has just withdrawn a product, and a sharp journalist asks what you do not want to answer. You answer without saying things outright - implication, understatement, irony that is marked so it lands, a corrected focus when her question presupposes something false, and a higher register when her question is crude - and twice you have to say what she actually meant. It listens for whether the implication lands, whether the focus correction is built with a particle and the Vorfeld, and whether the register holds. Say 'Ende' if you need to stop early.
tips[0].title: Name the job of the utterance
tips[0].text: Say the function first (Bitte, Absage, Vorwurf, Einwand), then the plain meaning. „Es zieht hier“ → Bitte: Mach das Fenster zu. „Bei Gelegenheit“ → Absage. „Sie sind ja früh dran“ (to a latecomer) → Vorwurf.
tips[0].check.why: A remark about the room is pointless on its own; its job is a request: Machen Sie bitte das Fenster auf.
tips[1].title: Imply and understate
tips[1].text: Let the listener draw the conclusion: an evaluative adverb (bezeichnenderweise), a litotes (nicht unerheblich, alles andere als, nicht ohne) or nicht gerade + a positive word says the negative without naming it.
tips[1].check.why: nicht gerade + a positive word lets the listener draw the negative conclusion without it being named.
tips[1].visual.rows[0].b: Das war nicht gerade ein Meisterwerk.
tips[1].visual.rows[1].b: Schön, dass du es auch noch geschafft hast.
tips[2].title: Signal irony so it lands
tips[2].text: Irony needs a marker, or it is heard as a plain statement: the particle ja, an exaggeration the facts contradict, or man könnte meinen + Konjunktiv. Say the ironic line, then let the fact follow.
tips[2].check.why: The particle ja plus praise that the following fact contradicts is what makes the irony land.
tips[3].title: Refocus with a particle and the Vorfeld
tips[3].text: Der Chef kam gestern. → Selbst der Chef kam gestern. / Erst gestern kam der Chef. / Ausgerechnet der Chef kam. Put the focus particle directly before the focused element and move that element into the Vorfeld.
tips[3].check.why: erst means 'not until': placed directly before gestern, it moves with it into the Vorfeld and puts the focus on the late moment.
tips[4].title: Paraphrase at one register
tips[4].text: Keep the meaning, raise the register — and keep it raised to the end of the sentence. An elevated noun–verb pair usually does the work.
tips[4].check.why: The elevated noun–verb pair is etwas einer Lösung zuführen: it keeps the meaning of lösen at a higher register.
remember[0]: Function first: Bitte, Absage, Vorwurf, Einwand.
remember[1]: Imply with bezeichnenderweise, nicht gerade, alles andere als; mark irony with ja or man könnte meinen.
remember[2]: Particle + Vorfeld = focus; keep the register consistent when paraphrasing.
hook: Say things without spelling them out: decode a hint, criticise by understatement, land irony and shift emphasis with one particle.
